v0.5.1.description:
Changelog:

v0.5.1:
Fixed a bug that caused the client to disconnect when connecting to a slot.

v0.5.0:
Added multiple new yaml options. Maximum checks have increased from 82 to 601.
Hero selection increased from maximum 8 to 16.
Added insane difficulty as an option for checks
Added Challenge maps as an unlock and checks
Added Survival mode as an unlock and checks
Added difficulties as progressive unlocks
Added challenges as an alternative goal instead of The Summit
Added an option to choose if map unlocks can appear locally or globally
Updated filler rewards - level ups and mana items have a few different values
World generation should give an error if you select too few checks compared to items
v0.5.1.title: Version 0.5.1

v0.5.2.description:
Changelog:
- Bank mana rewards now only give 25k, 50k, or 75k mana
- Level up rewards now only give 1 level
- Seeds now start with a random Eternia crystal
- Tweaked yaml
- Added nightmare and ruthless difficulty (requires DLC)
- Challenges as an unlock now unlocks in 3 parts, four levels at a time
- Survival as an unlock now unlocks in 3 parts, but still requires the campaign map to be unlocked
- Added item for harder seeds that gives progressive build time increase between waves. 10 seconds per unlock.
v0.5.2.title: Version 0.5.2

v0.5.3.description:
Changelog:
- Possible fix for split-screen bugs
- Fixed survival starting-wave selection
v0.5.3.title: Version 0.5.3

v0.6.0.description:
Changelog:

- Added Shopsanity with 27 permanent Tavern Shop checks. Purchases are unlocked after completing 1, 4 and 7 levels.
- Added Check Density options allowing fewer checks per level.
- Added `Random Gear Drop` filler rewards. Gear scales with the active hero level.
- Added 25 Crystal skins as unlocks. These have to be changed in the main menu
- Rebalanced filler items
- Improved Linux support
- Added safer handling for Archipelago callbacks and reconnects.
v0.6.0.title: Version 0.6.0

v0.6.1.description:
Changelog:
- Fixed map unlock balance. The previous limitations were not registering, causing late-game maps to appear in logic early.

Existing 0.6.0 users only need to install the new apworld. New seeds are required.
v0.6.1.title: Version 0.6.1

v0.6.2.description:
Changelog:
- Improved the random gear drops to scale on the same logic as the tavern shop items.
- Added an optional 2x–10x level catch-up multiplier. Lower level heroes gain extra exp until they reach the highest level hero you have. Also works for split-screen.
- Fixed the "Treasure Hunt" challenge potentially stopping further checks and rewards.
- Fixed Archipelago release/collect potentially triggering false map victories or completing the Summit goal.
- Fixed One Hero Level rewards targeting another split-screen player instead of player one.
- Removed Spider Minion from the Summoner’s possible starting summons.
- Renamed Shopsanity checks to Bronze, Silver, and Gold.
v0.6.2.title: Version 0.6.2
